item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://wp-zupet.bugfinder.app.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

item.content:encoded:
Gentle hands. Happy paws. Always.

Reliable Pet

Service

Nearby at Home

At Zupet, we believe pets are family. That’s why we offer compassionate, professional care tailored to your pet’s unique needs. From vet visits to grooming and wellness — we’re here for every paw, purr, and wag.

Book Now Book Now Schedule a Call
Hygiene Certification
100% Protection
Get free consultation get free consultation

At Zupet, our mission is to provide compassionate, expert care that strengthens the bond between pets and their people. We believe every animal deserves love, comfort, and personalized attention—whether it’s for health, grooming, or daily care. Our team of pet lovers and certified professionals is committed to safety, wellness, and happiness at every step. From tail wags to purrs, we’re here to make every visit stress-free and joyful. Because your pets aren’t just animals—they’re family, and they deserve the best.

More About Us More About Us

Our vision is to create a world where every pet is well-fed, cared for, and loved. We aim to be the leading choice for pet owners by offering products and services that make a real difference in pets’ lives. We envision a future where no pet suffers from poor nutrition or lack of care — a future where healthy, happy pets are the norm in every household. We dream of growing beyond a local store, building an online presence that allows us to serve pet ownersnationwide, delivering love and care straight to their doorstep.

More About Us More About Us

Founded out of a deep passion for animals, Cat Food Dog Pet Shop started as a small neighborhood store dedicated to offering premium-quality pet food. Over the years, our commitment to pet health and customer satisfaction has helped us grow into a trusted name in the pet care industry. From humble beginnings, we have expanded our selection to include not only food but also toys, accessories, grooming products, and health essentials. Every step of our journey has been guided by our love for animals.

More About Us More About Us

We provide expert, loving care for pets of all kinds from grooming and vet visits to daily walks and more. Service is designed with your pet’s comfort.

item.content:encoded:
We provide expert, loving care for pets of all kinds from grooming and vet visits to daily walks and more. Service is designed with your pet’s comfort.

Your Pet’s Happiness,
Our Promise

We provide personalized, reliable care tailored to your pet’s needs. Trust our expert team for safe, loving support every time.

Personalized Pet Attention

We treat every pet as an individual with unique needs. Our care is tailored to their personality, comfort, and routine.

Experienced & Certified Team

Our certified professionals bring years of trusted pet care experience. Your pet is in safe, skilled, and loving hands.

  • Hopeful Mindset
  • Endless Possibility
  • Positive Outlook

Customizable Appointment Times

We offer flexible scheduling to fit your busy lifestyle. Book appointments at your convenience morning, evening, or weekend.

24/7 Emergency Support

We provide 24/7 emergency support, ensuring your pets receive immediate, caring assistance whenever they need it most.

Ready to Build Together

What Our Clients Say About Us

Working with this team has been an absolute pleasure from day one.They took the time to truly understand our needs and goals. Every step of the process was handled with care and professionalism. Their creativity and attention to detail exceeded our expectations. The communication was always clear, timely, and solution-focused. Revisions were handled quickly, and feedback was always welcomed. The final product not only looks amazing but works flawlessly. They brought our vision to life better than we imagined. It’s rare to find such a reliable and talented team. We highly recommend them for any design or development project!

item.title: Grooming Services
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Grooming Services

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Schedule

9.00 am -2.00 pm

Price

$39.00

Reserve Now Reserve Now

About the Service

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Each session is handled with care by trained professionals who love animals. We use pet-safe products suited to your pet’s skin and coat type. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. Handled with love using safe, gentle products for all breeds.

Bathing & Brushing

Our bathing and brushing service keeps your pet’s coat clean, soft, and free from tangles. It also helps reduce shedding and promotes healthy skin.

Haircuts & Styling

Our haircuts and styling service offers breed-specific or custom trims to suit your pet’s look. We ensure your pet stays neat, comfortable, and adorable all year round.

Nail Trimming

Our nail trimming service ensures your pet’s nails are kept short, safe, and comfortable. It helps prevent overgrowth, pain, and potential injuries during play or walks.

Pet-Safe Products

We use only pet-safe, gentle products that protect your pet’s skin and coat. Our grooming treatments are designed to be safe, effective, and allergy-friendly.

The final product not only looks amazing but works flawlessly. They brought our vision to life better than we imagined. It’s rare to find such a reliable and talented team. item.title: Tommy
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Tommy

(Cocker Spaniel)

Meet Tommy, a loving and playful dog ready for his forever home. With a gentle heart and joyful spirit, he brings endless happiness.

  • Age: 3 Years
  • Gender: Male
  • Size: Medium
  • Breed: Labrador Retriever Mix
  • Vaccinated: Yes
  • Neutered: Yes
  • Training: Basic obedience trained
Adopt Me Adopt Me

Pappu

(Working dog)

Meet Tommy, a loving and playful dog ready for his forever home. With a gentle heart and joyful spirit, he brings endless happiness.

  • Age: 3 Years
  • Gender: Male
  • Size: Medium
  • Breed: Labrador Retriever Mix
  • Vaccinated: Yes
  • Neutered: Yes
  • Training: Basic obedience trained
Adopt Me Adopt Me

Find Your Perfect Companion – Adopt Me Today!

Every pet has a story, and yours could be their happy ending. we believe every animal deserves a safe, loving home. Our adoptable pets are vaccinated, healthy, and ready for a fresh start. Whether you're looking for a playful pup or a calm companion, we’ve got the perfect match. Each adoption gives a homeless pet a second chance at life. Our team will guide you through every step of the adoption process. You’ll receive full support, care tips, and resources to help your pet adjust. Bringing a pet home means gaining a loyal friend for life. It’s more than adoption—it’s the beginning of a lifelong bond. Adopt today and change two lives—yours and theirs.

Tommy’s Needs

  • Daily Exercise: Regular walks and playtime to stay active and happy
  • Affection & Attention: Loves cuddles, belly rubs, and quality time with people
  • Safe Environment: A calm, pet-friendly home with space to move around
  • Consistent Routine: Regular feeding, potty breaks, and a cozy sleeping area
  • Gentle Training: Responds well to basic commands and positive reinforcement

Tommy needs a cozy bed where he can rest and feel safe. He enjoys chew toys and playtime to stay active and happy. Healthy treats help with training and bonding moments. Regular grooming keeps him clean and comfortable. He thrives with gentle attention, outdoor walks, and positive interaction.

item.content:encoded:
Mochi

(Scottish Fold)

Meet Tommy, a loving and playful dog ready for his forever home. With a gentle heart and joyful spirit, he brings endless happiness.

  • Age: 3 Years
  • Gender: Male
  • Size: Medium
  • Breed: Labrador Retriever Mix
  • Vaccinated: Yes
  • Neutered: Yes
  • Training: Basic obedience trained
Adopt Me Adopt Me

Find Your Perfect Companion – Adopt Me Today!

Every pet has a story, and yours could be their happy ending. we believe every animal deserves a safe, loving home. Our adoptable pets are vaccinated, healthy, and ready for a fresh start. Whether you're looking for a playful pup or a calm companion, we’ve got the perfect match. Each adoption gives a homeless pet a second chance at life. Our team will guide you through every step of the adoption process. You’ll receive full support, care tips, and resources to help your pet adjust. Bringing a pet home means gaining a loyal friend for life. It’s more than adoption—it’s the beginning of a lifelong bond. Adopt today and change two lives—yours and theirs.

Tommy’s Needs

  • Daily Exercise: Regular walks and playtime to stay active and happy
  • Affection & Attention: Loves cuddles, belly rubs, and quality time with people
  • Safe Environment: A calm, pet-friendly home with space to move around
  • Consistent Routine: Regular feeding, potty breaks, and a cozy sleeping area
  • Gentle Training: Responds well to basic commands and positive reinforcement

Tommy needs a cozy bed where he can rest and feel safe. He enjoys chew toys and playtime to stay active and happy. Healthy treats help with training and bonding moments. Regular grooming keeps him clean and comfortable. He thrives with gentle attention, outdoor walks, and positive interaction.

Adopting a pet brings unconditional love and lifelong companionship. Give a deserving animal a second chance at a happy home.

item.content:encoded:
Tuna

(Oriental Shorthair)

Meet Tommy, a loving and playful dog ready for his forever home. With a gentle heart and joyful spirit, he brings endless happiness.

  • Age: 3 Years
  • Gender: Male
  • Size: Medium
  • Breed: Labrador Retriever Mix
  • Vaccinated: Yes
  • Neutered: Yes
  • Training: Basic obedience trained
Adopt Me Adopt Me

Find Your Perfect Companion – Adopt Me Today!

Every pet has a story, and yours could be their happy ending. we believe every animal deserves a safe, loving home. Our adoptable pets are vaccinated, healthy, and ready for a fresh start. Whether you're looking for a playful pup or a calm companion, we’ve got the perfect match. Each adoption gives a homeless pet a second chance at life. Our team will guide you through every step of the adoption process. You’ll receive full support, care tips, and resources to help your pet adjust. Bringing a pet home means gaining a loyal friend for life. It’s more than adoption—it’s the beginning of a lifelong bond. Adopt today and change two lives—yours and theirs.

Tommy’s Needs

  • Daily Exercise: Regular walks and playtime to stay active and happy
  • Affection & Attention: Loves cuddles, belly rubs, and quality time with people
  • Safe Environment: A calm, pet-friendly home with space to move around
  • Consistent Routine: Regular feeding, potty breaks, and a cozy sleeping area
  • Gentle Training: Responds well to basic commands and positive reinforcement

Tommy needs a cozy bed where he can rest and feel safe. He enjoys chew toys and playtime to stay active and happy. Healthy treats help with training and bonding moments. Regular grooming keeps him clean and comfortable. He thrives with gentle attention, outdoor walks, and positive interaction.

Start a Beautiful Journey with Pet Adoption

Adopting a pet brings unconditional love and lifelong companionship. Give a deserving animal a second chance at a happy home.

Veterinary Care

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Schedule

9.00 am -2.00 pm

Price

$39.00

Reserve Now Reserve Now

About the Service

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Each session is handled with care by trained professionals who love animals. We use pet-safe products suited to your pet’s skin and coat type. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. Handled with love using safe, gentle products for all breeds.

Bathing & Brushing

Our bathing and brushing service keeps your pet’s coat clean, soft, and free from tangles. It also helps reduce shedding and promotes healthy skin.

Haircuts & Styling

Our haircuts and styling service offers breed-specific or custom trims to suit your pet’s look. We ensure your pet stays neat, comfortable, and adorable all year round.

Nail Trimming

Our nail trimming service ensures your pet’s nails are kept short, safe, and comfortable. It helps prevent overgrowth, pain, and potential injuries during play or walks.

Pet-Safe Products

We use only pet-safe, gentle products that protect your pet’s skin and coat. Our grooming treatments are designed to be safe, effective, and allergy-friendly.

Overnight Pet Care

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Schedule

9.00 am -2.00 pm

Price

$39.00

Reserve Now Reserve Now

About the Service

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Each session is handled with care by trained professionals who love animals. We use pet-safe products suited to your pet’s skin and coat type. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. Handled with love using safe, gentle products for all breeds.

Bathing & Brushing

Our bathing and brushing service keeps your pet’s coat clean, soft, and free from tangles. It also helps reduce shedding and promotes healthy skin.

Haircuts & Styling

Our haircuts and styling service offers breed-specific or custom trims to suit your pet’s look. We ensure your pet stays neat, comfortable, and adorable all year round.

Nail Trimming

Our nail trimming service ensures your pet’s nails are kept short, safe, and comfortable. It helps prevent overgrowth, pain, and potential injuries during play or walks.

Pet-Safe Products

We use only pet-safe, gentle products that protect your pet’s skin and coat. Our grooming treatments are designed to be safe, effective, and allergy-friendly.

item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Pet Training Programs

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Schedule

9.00 am -2.00 pm

Price

$39.00

Reserve Now Reserve Now

About the Service

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Each session is handled with care by trained professionals who love animals. We use pet-safe products suited to your pet’s skin and coat type. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. Handled with love using safe, gentle products for all breeds.

Bathing & Brushing

Our bathing and brushing service keeps your pet’s coat clean, soft, and free from tangles. It also helps reduce shedding and promotes healthy skin.

Haircuts & Styling

Our haircuts and styling service offers breed-specific or custom trims to suit your pet’s look. We ensure your pet stays neat, comfortable, and adorable all year round.

Nail Trimming

Our nail trimming service ensures your pet’s nails are kept short, safe, and comfortable. It helps prevent overgrowth, pain, and potential injuries during play or walks.

Pet-Safe Products

We use only pet-safe, gentle products that protect your pet’s skin and coat. Our grooming treatments are designed to be safe, effective, and allergy-friendly.

item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Pet Boarding & Daycare

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Schedule

9.00 am -2.00 pm

Price

$39.00

Reserve Now Reserve Now

About the Service

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Each session is handled with care by trained professionals who love animals. We use pet-safe products suited to your pet’s skin and coat type. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. Handled with love using safe, gentle products for all breeds.

Bathing & Brushing

Our bathing and brushing service keeps your pet’s coat clean, soft, and free from tangles. It also helps reduce shedding and promotes healthy skin.

Haircuts & Styling

Our haircuts and styling service offers breed-specific or custom trims to suit your pet’s look. We ensure your pet stays neat, comfortable, and adorable all year round.

Nail Trimming

Our nail trimming service ensures your pet’s nails are kept short, safe, and comfortable. It helps prevent overgrowth, pain, and potential injuries during play or walks.

Pet-Safe Products

We use only pet-safe, gentle products that protect your pet’s skin and coat. Our grooming treatments are designed to be safe, effective, and allergy-friendly.

item.title: Hello world!
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded: Welcome to WordPress. This is your first post. Edit or delete it, then start writing!

wp:comment.wp:comment_content: Hi, this is a comment. To get started with moderating, editing, and deleting comments, please visit the Comments screen in the dashboard. Commenter avatars come from Gravatar.

item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: http://zupet.test.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: Refund and Returns Policy
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
This is a sample page.

Overview

Our refund and returns policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have passed since your purchase, we can’t offer you a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

  • Gift cards
  • Downloadable software products
  • Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted:

  • Book with obvious signs of use
  • CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.
  • Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.
  • Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at {email address}.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at {email address} and send your item to: {physical address}.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and they will find out about your return.

Shipping returns

To return your product, you should mail your product to: {physical address}.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you may vary.

If you are returning more expensive items, you may consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Contact us at {email} for questions related to refunds and returns.

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
New Pet Owner Guidance

Professional grooming services that keep your pet clean, healthy, and looking their best. From baths to trims, we handle it all with gentle care.

Schedule

9.00 am -2.00 pm

Price

$39.00

Reserve Now Reserve Now

About the Service

Our grooming services are designed to keep your pet looking and feeling great. We offer baths, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and more. Each session is handled with care by trained professionals who love animals. We use pet-safe products suited to your pet’s skin and coat type. Whether it’s a routine cleanup or a fresh new style, your pet is in good hands. Our grooming services ensure your pet stays clean, healthy, and stylish. Handled with love using safe, gentle products for all breeds.

Bathing & Brushing

Our bathing and brushing service keeps your pet’s coat clean, soft, and free from tangles. It also helps reduce shedding and promotes healthy skin.

Haircuts & Styling

Our haircuts and styling service offers breed-specific or custom trims to suit your pet’s look. We ensure your pet stays neat, comfortable, and adorable all year round.

Nail Trimming

Our nail trimming service ensures your pet’s nails are kept short, safe, and comfortable. It helps prevent overgrowth, pain, and potential injuries during play or walks.

Pet-Safe Products

We use only pet-safe, gentle products that protect your pet’s skin and coat. Our grooming treatments are designed to be safe, effective, and allergy-friendly.

What Our Clients Say About Us

Working with this team has been an absolute pleasure from day one.They took the time to truly understand our needs and goals. Every step of the process was handled with care and professionalism. Their creativity and attention to detail exceeded our expectations. The communication was always clear, timely, and solution-focused. Revisions were handled quickly, and feedback was always welcomed. The final product not only looks amazing but works flawlessly. They brought our vision to life better than we imagined. It’s rare to find such a reliable and talented team. We highly recommend them for any design or development project!

item.title: Bag of dog food with a Dog
item.dc:creator: Zapet
item.content:encoded:
Our premium pet food is specially formulated to meet the unique nutritional needs of dogs, cats, and other pets at every stage of life. Made with high-quality, natural ingredients, it provides a balanced blend of proteins, vitamins, minerals, and essential nutrients to support optimal health, growth, and vitality.

Whether you have a playful puppy, an active adult dog, or a senior pet, our pet food helps maintain strong muscles, a healthy immune system, shiny coats, and proper digestion. Each recipe is carefully crafted to ensure your pets get the energy and nourishment they need while enjoying every meal.

We also focus on taste and palatability, so even the pickiest eaters will love mealtime. Free from artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives, our pet food gives you peace of mind knowing your furry friends are eating wholesome, safe, and nutritious food.

Choose our pet food to keep your pets healthy, happy, and full of life every day.
item.excerpt:encoded: Pet food provides balanced nutrition tailored to the specific needs of dogs, cats, and other pets. Made with high-quality ingredients, it supports overall health, growth, and vitality while keeping pets happy and active.
